recipes.title: Lemon Herb Roasted Chicken
recipes.name: Lemon Herb Roasted Chicken
recipes.shortDescription: A bright and zesty roasted chicken that's simple and satisfying.
recipes.description: A bright and zesty roasted chicken that's simple and satisfying.
recipes.cardDescription: Bright, zesty chicken perfect for weeknights.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the chicken dry.
Whisk oil, garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Rub mixture over chicken; stuff cavity with lemon halves.
Roast 45–55 minutes, until juices run clear and skin is crisp.
Rest 10 minutes, carve, and serve with pan juices.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Salad
recipes.name: Mediterranean Salad
recipes.shortDescription: Crisp veggies, olives, and tangy feta.
recipes.description: Crisp veggies, olives, and tangy feta.
instructions: Wash and dry all vegetables thoroughly.
Combine greens, tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion in a large bowl.
Add olives and crumbled feta cheese.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Drizzle dressing over salad and toss gently before serving.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.shortDescription: Classic Italian pasta with eggs, cheese, pancetta, and black pepper.
recipes.description: A creamy Roman pasta dish made without cream.
instructions: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Meanwhile, sauté pancetta until crispy.
Whisk eggs, cheeses, and pepper in a bowl.
Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of pasta water.
Mix hot pasta with pancetta, remove from heat.
Quickly stir in egg mixture, adding pasta water to create a creamy sauce.
Serve immediately with extra cheese and pepper.

recipes.title: Vegetable Stir Fry
recipes.name: Vegetable Stir Fry
recipes.shortDescription: Colorful veggies in a savory soy-ginger sauce.
recipes.description: Quick and nutritious stir-fry perfect for busy nights.
recipes.cardDescription: Fast, healthy, and full of color.
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet.
Add garlic and ginger, stir for 30 seconds.
Add carrots and broccoli, stir-fry for 4-5 minutes.
Add bell peppers and snap peas, cook 3 more minutes.
Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, and honey.
Pour sauce over vegetables, toss to coat.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.

recipes.title: Classic Beef Burger
recipes.name: Classic Beef Burger
recipes.shortDescription: Juicy beef patty with cheese, lettuce, and tomato.
instructions: Divide beef into 4 patties, season with salt and pepper.
Grill or pan-fry patties for 4-5 minutes per side.
Add cheese slices during the last minute to melt.
Toast burger buns lightly.
Assemble burgers with lettuce, tomato, onion, and condiments.
Serve with fries or a side salad.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Curry
recipes.name: Creamy Chicken Curry
recipes.shortDescription: Tender chicken in a spiced coconut milk sauce.
recipes.description: Aromatic and mildly spicy curry perfect with rice.
instructions: Heat oil, sauté onion until soft.
Add garlic, ginger, curry powder, cook 1 minute.
Add chicken, brown for 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and coconut milk.
Simmer covered for 20-25 minutes until chicken is tender.
Season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with cilantro, serve with rice or naan.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast
recipes.name: Avocado Toast
recipes.shortDescription: Mashed avocado on toasted sourdough with seasoning.
recipes.description: A trendy, healthy breakfast or snack.
ingredients: Optional: poached egg, cherry tomatoes, microgreens
instructions: Toast bread until golden and crisp.
Mash avocado with lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread avocado mixture on toast.
Sprinkle with red pepper flakes.
Top with optional ingredients if desired.

recipes.title: Beef Tacos
recipes.name: Beef Tacos
recipes.shortDescription: Seasoned ground beef in crispy taco shells with toppings.
instructions: Brown ground beef in a skillet, drain fat.
Add taco seasoning and water, simmer 5 minutes.
Heat taco shells according to package.
Fill shells with beef, top with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese.
Serve with sour cream and salsa.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi
recipes.name: Shrimp Scampi
recipes.shortDescription: Garlic butter shrimp served over pasta.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.
Heat butter and oil, sauté garlic 1 minute.
Add shrimp, cook until pink.
Pour in wine and lemon juice, simmer 2 minutes.
Toss with drained pasta, garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Caesar Salad
recipes.name: Caesar Salad
recipes.shortDescription: Crisp romaine with creamy Caesar dressing and croutons.
recipes.description: A classic salad with homemade dressing.
instructions: Wash and dry romaine leaves.
Toss lettuce with dressing in a large bowl.
Add croutons and half the Parmesan.
Top with remaining cheese and optional proteins.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.shortDescription: Creamy Italian rice with mushrooms and Parmesan.
recipes.cardDescription: Rich, creamy, and full of umami.
instructions: Heat broth in a saucepan, keep warm.
Sauté onions and mushrooms in butter and oil.
Add rice, toast 2 minutes.
Pour in wine, stir until absorbed.
Add broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently.
When rice is creamy and tender, stir in Parmesan.
Season and serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.shortDescription: Hearty soup with chicken, vegetables, and noodles.
recipes.description: The ultimate comfort food for cold days.
instructions: Sauté onions, carrots, celery in oil until soft.
Add chicken, cook until no longer pink.
Pour in broth, bring to a boil.
Add noodles, simmer 10 minutes until tender.
Season with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Fluffy Pancakes
recipes.name: Fluffy Pancakes
recipes.shortDescription: Light, fluffy pancakes perfect for breakfast.
recipes.description: A classic breakfast treat with maple syrup.
instructions: Mix dry ingredients in a bowl.
Whisk milk, egg, and butter in another bowl.
Combine wet and dry until just mixed.
Heat a non-stick pan, pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake.
Flip when bubbles form, cook until golden.
Serve with syrup.

recipes.title: Hearty Lentil Soup
recipes.name: Hearty Lentil Soup
recipes.shortDescription: Warming soup with lentils, carrots, and spices.
instructions: Sauté onion, carrots, celery in oil until soft.
Add garlic and cumin, cook 1 minute.
Add lentils and broth, bring to a boil.
Simmer 30-40 minutes until lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot with bread.

recipes.title: Vegetable Sushi Rolls
recipes.name: Vegetable Sushi Rolls
recipes.shortDescription: Homemade sushi rolls with cucumber, avocado, and carrot.
recipes.description: Fresh, light, and fun to make at home.
instructions: Cook sushi rice according to package, let cool.
Place nori on bamboo mat, spread rice evenly.
Arrange vegetables in a line near the edge.
Roll tightly using the mat.
Slice into pieces with a wet knife.
Serve with soy sauce, ginger, and wasabi.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.shortDescription: Soft, chewy cookies loaded with chocolate chips.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cream butter and sugars until fluffy.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix in flour and baking soda.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Drop spoonfuls onto baking sheets.
Bake 9-12 minutes until edges are golden.
Cool on wire racks.

recipes.title: Hummus Plate
recipes.name: Hummus Plate
recipes.shortDescription: Creamy hummus served with pita and veggies.
recipes.description: A Middle Eastern appetizer or light meal.
recipes.cardDescription: Creamy, garlicky, and perfect for dipping.
ingredients: Pita bread, cucumber, carrots for serving
instructions: Blend chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon juice until smooth.
Add water or oil to reach desired consistency.
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle paprika.
Serve with warm pita and sliced vegetables.
